summary: Overall risk score: 38.79/100 across 28 non-compliant findings.
board_message: CRIS-SME highlights the highest-risk cloud governance issues, the most practical fixes for the next 30 days, and the organisation's current UK-readiness signals.

top_risks.title: Administrative services are exposed to the public internet
top_risks.remediation_summary: Restrict SSH and RDP exposure with private access paths, VPN, or just-in-time controls.

top_risks.title: Privileged role assignments without MFA enforcement
top_risks.remediation_summary: Require MFA and admin-focused conditional access for privileged identities.

top_risks.title: Public storage access increases data exposure risk
top_risks.remediation_summary: Disable anonymous or public storage access and review data exposure paths.

top_risks.title: IoT Hub public network access is not sufficiently constrained
top_risks.remediation_summary: Restrict IoT Hub public access using IP filters, private endpoints, or documented clinical network boundaries.

top_risks.title: Network security group rules are broader than expected
top_risks.remediation_summary: Tighten overly permissive network rules to least-privilege source and port scopes.

benchmark_note: Benchmark comparison is scaffolded, but fewer than three comparable peer observations are currently available for a meaningful percentile ranking.

action_plan_summary.label: Fix this week
action_plan_summary.goal: Prioritize zero-cost or low-friction fixes that reduce immediate exposure.

actions.title: Privileged role assignments without MFA enforcement
actions.remediation_summary: Require MFA and admin-focused conditional access for privileged identities.
actions.action_rationale: Placed in 'Fix this week' because it carries high urgency, a 67.97 risk score, and a free remediation cost profile.

actions.title: Public storage access increases data exposure risk
actions.remediation_summary: Disable anonymous or public storage access and review data exposure paths.
actions.action_rationale: Placed in 'Fix this week' because it carries planned urgency, a 48.35 risk score, and a free remediation cost profile.

actions.title: Network security group rules are broader than expected
actions.remediation_summary: Tighten overly permissive network rules to least-privilege source and port scopes.
actions.action_rationale: Placed in 'Fix this week' because it carries planned urgency, a 44.71 risk score, and a free remediation cost profile.

actions.title: IoT shared access policies exceed least-privilege expectations
actions.remediation_summary: Reduce IoT shared access policies, remove overbroad permissions, and rotate keys through governed operations.
actions.action_rationale: Placed in 'Fix this week' because it carries planned urgency, a 41.60 risk score, and a free remediation cost profile.

actions.title: Policy assignment coverage is below the baseline governance threshold
actions.remediation_summary: Increase baseline policy assignment coverage for governance and compliance controls.
actions.action_rationale: Placed in 'Fix this week' because it carries planned urgency, a 33.88 risk score, and a free remediation cost profile.

action_plan_summary.label: Complete this month
action_plan_summary.goal: Deliver the best remaining low-cost improvements within a lean SME operating window.

actions.title: Stale service principals or credentials require review
actions.remediation_summary: Rotate or remove stale service principal credentials and disable unused identities.
actions.action_rationale: Placed in 'Complete this month' because it carries monitor urgency, a 23.34 risk score, and a free remediation cost profile.

actions.title: Orphaned resources increase governance and cost hygiene risk
actions.remediation_summary: Review and remove unused or orphaned resources to reduce cost and governance noise.
actions.action_rationale: Placed in 'Complete this month' because it carries monitor urgency, a 17.87 risk score, and a free remediation cost profile.

actions.title: Budget alerting is not enabled for cloud cost governance
actions.remediation_summary: Configure budget thresholds and spend alerts for cost oversight.
actions.action_rationale: Placed in 'Complete this month' because it carries monitor urgency, a 16.39 risk score, and a free remediation cost profile.

actions.title: Clinical-operational ownership boundaries require human validation
actions.remediation_summary: Document clinical, operational, and supplier ownership boundaries for IoMT assets and validate device-level evidence manually.
actions.action_rationale: Placed in 'Complete this month' because it carries monitor urgency, a 4.72 risk score, and a free remediation cost profile.

actions.title: IoT Hub public network access is not sufficiently constrained
actions.remediation_summary: Restrict IoT Hub public access using IP filters, private endpoints, or documented clinical network boundaries.
actions.action_rationale: Placed in 'Complete this month' because it carries planned urgency, a 47.25 risk score, and a low remediation cost profile.

actions.title: Data stores lack expected encryption protections
actions.remediation_summary: Enable encryption at rest for affected storage and database services.
actions.action_rationale: Placed in 'Complete this month' because it carries planned urgency, a 42.36 risk score, and a low remediation cost profile.

actions.title: Activity log retention is below governance and investigation expectations
actions.remediation_summary: Increase log retention to support investigation, governance review, and evidence preservation.
actions.action_rationale: Placed in 'Complete this month' because it carries planned urgency, a 35.79 risk score, and a low remediation cost profile.

action_plan_summary.label: Plan next

actions.title: IoT credential governance is not linked to managed secret controls
actions.remediation_summary: Store and rotate IoT credentials through governed key-management services with owner accountability.
actions.action_rationale: Placed in 'Plan next' because it carries monitor urgency, a 21.98 risk score, and a low remediation cost profile.

actions.title: IoT diagnostic logging is incomplete for clinical telemetry investigation
actions.remediation_summary: Enable IoT Hub diagnostic settings and route core diagnostic categories to a monitored destination.
actions.action_rationale: Placed in 'Plan next' because it carries monitor urgency, a 21.77 risk score, and a low remediation cost profile.

actions.title: IoMT telemetry routing and retention are below clinical evidence expectations

actions.action_rationale: Placed in 'Plan next' because it carries monitor urgency, a 20.93 risk score, and a low remediation cost profile.

actions.title: Clinical IoT alert routing is not operationally evidenced
actions.remediation_summary: Create IoT-specific alert rules and route them to accountable clinical or operational responders.
actions.action_rationale: Placed in 'Plan next' because it carries monitor urgency, a 20.30 risk score, and a low remediation cost profile.

actions.title: Identity governance observability is partial for this assessment scope
actions.remediation_summary: Broaden tenant-level identity evidence collection before treating IAM coverage as complete.
actions.action_rationale: Placed in 'Plan next' because it carries monitor urgency, a 4.57 risk score, and a low remediation cost profile.
